payload.expertText:
* = $0801
.region Consts
.const _color = $0
.const _delay = 30
.const _newline = $0D
.endregion

.region Init
.charset lower
.set_border _color
.set_bg _color
.clear_screen
.endregion

.region Print
.print "hello world!", lower
.print_char _newline
.delay _delay
.print "HELLO WORLD!", lower
.print_char _newline
.delay _delay
.print "hello WORLD!", lower
.print_char _newline
.delay _delay
.print "HELLO world!", lower
.print_char _newline
.endregion

.end

* = $0801
; INCLUDE demo — includes bitmap macros from include-library.json
; The INCLUDE block below loads include-library.json (BitmapOn, BitmapOff, HiresClearScreen, WaitForKey)
    SEI
; Enable hires bitmap mode, clear screen, wait for key, then disable
    JSR $E544
.invoke StartScreen
.invoke WaitForKey
.invoke BitmapOn
.invoke HiresClearScreen
.invoke WaitForKey
.invoke BitmapOff
    RTS
.include "macros", $1500
.macro StartScreen
    JSR $E544
.text 1, 1, "hires-on"
.text 1, 2, "clear screen and clear color ram"
.text 1, 3, "press key and then press key again!"
.endm
